content:
If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 5–10% in mid-horizon.

If sentiment is positive and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 5–10% in early horizon.

If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and forecast is flat, shift forecast 2–3 points toward historical mean in late horizon.

If sentiment is consistently low (0.00–0.33) and forecast is above 65, reduce forecast by 3–7% in mid-horizon.

If sentiment is high (0.67–1.00) and forecast is below 60, increase forecast by 3–7% in early horizon.

If sentiment flips from negative to positive within 5 days, adjust forecast upward by 2–5% in late horizon.
